title: I’m making a match-3 roguelike where spells shatter after one cast. Looking for first-run feedback.
author: hippieman
selftext:
I’ve been building Swap Quest with Codex. I built it in Phaser, as I had always wanted to try it.  It’s a browser-based match-3 roguelike: you match gems to charge spells, but each spell gem breaks when you cast it.

I recently replaced permanent spells because it was too easy to find one strong spell and keep relying on it. Now you bring three gems into a fight and decide which are worth spending.

Working with AI has also let me build an in-game content editor and testing tools to support these changes. Getting the systems working is one thing; finding out whether those decisions are clear and enjoyable is where I need fresh eyes.

**Play:** [**https://swapquest.replit.app/**](https://swapquest.replit.app/) **(Hosted on Replit, but not coded with Replit)**

Five or ten minutes would help. You don’t need to finish a run. **Where did you first feel unsure what to do?** Comments here are welcome, including if you stop early.

  
If you play on Mobile, you should install it as a web clip first, it's built to not have a URL bar.
